summary: Portable Godot gate and native build for Linux/macOS, the first CI workflow, and the island suite completing again

coordination.notes: Twins of the PowerShell gate and build script, same suites, same completion lines, same failure rules; the .gdextension gains linux and macos rows and game/bin/linux|macos are ignored rather than committed (the Windows DLLs stay tracked as they are). load_island now warns with the loader's stable reason token when it refuses a save; it refused silently before, which is how the island suite's synthetic removal stayed unexplained. The suite's removal step erased only the fort's obstacle while clearing every colonial holding; the loader rightly refuses an obstacle whose building is gone (invalid_saved_building_obstacles), and colonial expansion had raised a second holding by that point. The test now removes every colonial obstacle it clears and asserts the count it removed. No loader rule was loosened.
